Kevin Crawford

Yes, Kevin did write this tune. Donogh says that he named it after his dog!

BTW -- that tunebook is out now, and has been for a while. I have it, and it’s nice. Donogh wrote it, and he has something to say about each of the tunes, which I think is interesting, like who wrote it, or where they learned it.

-Max

↳ Posted by Scrappy the Godo on October 30th, 2009.

Rosie’s, X:3

A version I learned from Kevin Crawford in a class. Wind players will want to add some pauses for breaths, while others may want to skip some of the rest notes and improvise with another note.

I also learned a couple of variations.
For the first line of the B part: | z4 b4 | baag gffe |
For the 3rd line of the B part, there is this syncopated variation: | fBB gBB ag | fBB dBB ec |
